content.short: Folks Finance is a permissionless cross-chain lending platform for lending and borrowing.
content.description: Folks Finance provides lending and borrowing across multiple chains, with its xChain product letting a position span networks rather than requiring assets be bridged first. It began in the Algorand ecosystem and has since expanded to EVM chains including Monad.
